assumptions.choice: Reset entry evaluation timer back to 0 whenever an evaluation attempt occurs on the 20th bar, regardless of whether filters pass or fail.
assumptions.reason: The specification states 'once every 20 bars place a limit buy'. Maintaining a strict 20-bar evaluation cadence reflects this exact interval logic.

assumptions.choice: Unfilled limit buy orders are cancelled after 20 bars.
assumptions.reason: The specification states 'after each sell/buy cycle, reset new limit levels every 20 bars'. Cancelling unfilled limit buy orders after 20 bars allows recalculating BuyLim based on fresh indicator values.

assumptions.topic: Averaging Limit Buy Sizing and Pricing
assumptions.choice: Averaging tranches place limit buys at BuyLim = min(lowerBB, Close * 0.93) using size = int((portfolio_value * 0.03) / BuyLim).
assumptions.reason: The specification states 'add the next tranche using the same sizing rule until the limit of 3 tranches and 9% of the portfolio is reached', extending the entry sizing rule to additional tranches.

assumptions.choice: Records for each buy/sell cycle (entry/exit dates, prices, realized profit, tranche count, average price) are accumulated in self.cycle_records.
assumptions.reason: The specification explicitly requires keeping records of all cycles.
